fusions.name: Bar-Stiff Crack
fusions.desc: A rigid lash deals 14 damage, [Stuns] the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ingot Tip
fusions.desc: Hurls the weighted tip at the first enemy in reach for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Unbent
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Grey Wrappings
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% curse resistance.
